'''Gazz Spire''' was a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhol Yan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. The entrepreneur and [[Stargazers|Stargazer]] [[Kara (Je'daii)|Kara]] owned an apartment on the two hundredth floor of the tower.
